title: B2C Product Manager
description:
Location: Remote

Company

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part-time work, serving users in 140 countries and up to 20 languages.

What you will do

- Own the B2C product end to end, including its P&L.

- Set product direction and manage the 3–6 month roadmap across strategy, experimentation, and delivery.

- Drive acquisition, activation, and retention through hypothesis-driven experiments.

- Own product metrics and use data to guide prioritization and decisions.

- Conduct CustDev interviews to understand behavior across a global, multilingual audience.

- Partner with B2B product teams and report directly to the founder while taking over the product vertical.

Requirements

- 5+ years of product management experience.

- Strong B2C growth track record with experiments, acquisition, and measurable results.

- Experience scaling a product with strong product–market fit and improving growth, activation, and retention metrics.

- Strong product sense, a hypothesis-driven approach, and the ability to translate data into action.

- Startup or fast-moving, high-ownership experience with high autonomy and accountability.

- Fluent Russian.

Culture & Benefits

- Full ownership of a profitable, fast-growing product and its P&L.

- Compact team of fewer than 40 people with broad ownership and streamlined collaboration.

- Metrics-driven culture where every function owns measurable outcomes.

- Flat, cross-functional structure that supports validated ideas across product areas.

- Paid vacation and sick leave.
